title: Noteworthy Thursday Option Activity: AMZN, BKNG, AAPL
text:
Noteworthy Thursday Option Activity: AMZN, BKNG, AAPL November 29, 2018, 01:27:50 PM EDT By DividendChannel.com, BNK Invest Shutterstock photo
Looking at options trading activity among components of the S&P 500 index, there is noteworthy activity today in Amazon.com Inc (Symbol: AMZN), where a total volume of 125,874 contracts has been traded thus far today, a contract volume which is representative of approximately 12.6 million underlying shares (given that every 1 contract represents 100 underlying shares). That number works out to 184.7% of AMZN's average daily trading volume over the past month, of 6.8 million shares. Particularly high volume was seen for the $1700 strike call option expiring November 30, 2018 , with 6,047 contracts trading so far today, representing approximately 604,700 underlying shares of AMZN. Below is a chart showing AMZN's trailing twelve month trading history, with the $1700 strike highlighted in orange: Booking Holdings Inc (Symbol: BKNG) saw options trading volume of 6,187 contracts, representing approximately 618,700 underlying shares or approximately 136.7% of BKNG's average daily trading volume over the past month, of 452,640 shares. Particularly high volume was seen for the $1350 strike put option expiring December 21, 2018 , with 311 contracts trading so far today, representing approximately 31,100 underlying shares of BKNG. Particularly high volume was seen for the $180 strike call option expiring November 30, 2018 , with 42,430 contracts trading so far today, representing approximately 4.2 million underlying shares of AAPL.
